name: City of Gold
description: This stronghold, once protected by seven mighty battlements, crumbled overnight when King Deshret fell and an age of chaos ensued. Where gold-eyed warriors once stood guard over watchtowers of gilded luster, now, only a desiccated temple built upon sundered rocks remains, more akin to a tomb for an age of radiance long lost.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Desert Citadel I
tabs.description:
Lost and abandoned for centuries, the ruins of this city have become a resting place for paltry beings.
Should you manage to sweep away the monsters inside like a gust of desert wind, you might just find yourself a few rare Artifacts richer.
